spec.title: Tiled Online Attention
spec.summary: A fixed query tile consumes successive key/value tiles; online row statistics and an unnormalized output accumulator persist across iterations.

spec.layout: Show the one-tile computation with parallel K_j and V_j inputs and a fixed Q_i input. Put persistent (m,l,A) state in a distinct nearby lane, with original feedback directions returning previous m to row normalization and previous l,A to accumulation. Accumulator updates return to state. Route final l,A to the final normalization only after j completes; this exit is distinct from the recurrence. Loop frame means repeat over tiles, not physical copies. Do not draw dense N × N storage or invent extra tile-index control edges.
annotations: Row vectors broadcast across score columns and accumulator columns as appropriate.
P_j contains unnormalized exponentials; normalization occurs once after the tile loop.
Only tile-local scores and probabilities exist on chip; no dense N × N intermediate is written to HBM.
assumptions: Unmasked single-head forward attention; no dropout, backward pass or logsumexp output.
Boundary tiles may be shorter; padding and scheduling details are omitted.

description: 画一张 tiled online attention 的算法数据流图，展示固定 Q_i tile 与流式 K_j、V_j tile，重点是跨 tile 的在线归一化和累加状态，不要画成普通直线链条。Q_i 为 B_r × d_k，K_j 为 B_c × d_k，V_j 为 B_c × d_v。每个 j 计算 S_j = Q_i K_j^T / sqrt(d_k)。维护 m、l 和未归一化 A：m_new = max(m, rowmax(S_j))，alpha = exp(m - m_new)，P_j = exp(S_j - m_new)；l_new = alpha*l + rowsum(P_j)，A_new = diag(alpha)A + P_j V_j。状态初值 m=-inf、l=0、A=0；每个 tile 更新后反馈供下个 j 使用。所有 K/V tiles 完成后才输出 O_i=diag(l)^(-1)A。Q tile 和状态驻留片上，K/V 逐块装入，不把完整 N × N 分数写回 HBM。无 causal mask、无 dropout，省略 backward/logsumexp 输出。
